items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: So we made 'Two Little Fishes and Five Loaves of Bread' and it was a big hit. 'Up Above My Head' on the opposite side. And we did.

ctx.x: With Rosetta Tharpe and you said you made that arrangement with her that...

Well I made it with Decca because she didn't want to pay me. And never...Rosetta Tharpe never gave me a Christmas card. And I made her a lot of money. You see, Dan, this is the thing about my piano playing-- if my piano can benefit somebody, I'm not jealous.

When I went to Germany right now, and it cost me, believe me...see, it cost me four hundred and forty dollars and then five hundred and eighty,-- all right?--to make $2500. So my profit is fifteen hundred dollars which is not fair to me because, you know, that's not really...you know...I've got to travel, you know what I mean, a great distance, and then I've gotta appear, I've gotta be there, you know what I mean, then you've got to buy your food and, you know, but I'm very conservative about my eating because,…
